description:
Bring photos from compatible Panasonic Image App-era cameras straight to your iPhone. GM1 Sync connects directly to the camera's Wi-Fi network, shows the SD card as a fast photo gallery, and imports original JPEG files into Apple Photos.

ONE CAMERA MODE
On the Panasonic DMC-GM1S, use Wi-Fi → New Connection → Remote Shooting & View → Direct → Image App. The same connection handles browsing, previews, and original downloads.

BROWSE THE CAMERA
• Load the newest photos first
• Scroll through the complete camera card
• Open a larger preview before importing
• Select one photo or a batch

KEEP THE ORIGINAL
GM1 Sync imports the original JPEG advertised by the camera. It does not recompress the image or delete anything from the SD card.

OPTIONAL GEOTAGGING
Start a visible location log before shooting. During import, GM1 Sync can match the camera's EXIF capture time to a nearby track point and add that location to the Apple Photos asset. Location logging is off by default and all track data stays on the iPhone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There are no accounts, ads, analytics, trackers, or cloud uploads. Camera traffic stays on the direct local Wi-Fi connection. The app requests add-only Photos access and does not read your existing photo library.

COMPATIBILITY
The Panasonic DMC-GM1S is the primary validated camera. The GM1, GM5, and other Panasonic Image App-era models are potential candidates but may vary by model and firmware.

GM1 Sync is independent software and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Panasonic. Panasonic and LUMIX are trademarks of their respective owner.
promotionalText: Browse your classic camera, preview every shot, and import original JPEGs over one direct Wi-Fi connection.
